name: Belmond Miraflores Park
positioning: Belmond's Miraflores Park, a contemporary oceanfront hotel in Lima on the clifftop malecón above the Pacific
best_for: Travelers who want a Lima base on the clifftop malecón
Guests who want a suite with a terrace or plunge pool
Diners who want modern Peruvian cooking at the hotel

facts.text: The hotel opened under the Orient-Express brand and joined Belmond in 2014.
The hotel sits on the malecón, the clifftop park along the Pacific, across from a small park.
It is near the new footbridge to Barranco, which makes it easy to reach that neighborhood's restaurants.
Barranco is a 15 minute walk from the hotel.
Some suites have a terrace or plunge pool.
All of the rooms are treated as suites, with most offering a balcony, an in-room sauna, or a terrace with a plunge pool, depending on category.
Tragaluz is the hotel's restaurant for modern Peruvian dining.
Belo Bar serves creative cocktails and local spirits.
Zest Spa uses organic products from the Amazon.
The hotel has a heated rooftop swimming pool.

considerations.text: Condé Nast Traveler says a series of upgrades, including to the rooftop pool, was underway ahead of Peru's summer, and advises asking the hotel ahead what may be under construction in 2026.
The airport is a 45 minute drive from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive positioning.
